basics.name: Danil Shubin
basics.label: Senior Backend Developer (Java / Kotlin / Spring Boot)
basics.summary: Result-driven Senior Backend Developer with 9+ years of IT experience, specializing in designing, building, and scaling high-throughput distributed systems using Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot. Pioneer in accelerating development lifecycle through advanced AI/LLM orchestration (MCP architecture, custom Agentic workflows, Open-source models). Expert in microservices architecture, cloud-native environments, legacy system decommissioning, and high-load financial platforms with a deep focus on clean architecture, robust integration workflows, and continuous delivery.

work.name: Raiffeisen Bank Russia
highlights: Designed, developed, and maintained 10+ mission-critical microservices using Kotlin (including Coroutines), Java, and Spring Boot for SME banking serving thousands of active daily users
Successfully led the complex decommissioning of legacy CRM systems, architecting and implementing new high-performance substitute services from scratch without business interruption
Architected asynchronous, event-driven data flows using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Apache Avro for strongly-typed schema registry and data serialization
Re-engineered database persistence layers leveraging jOOQ, MapStruct, and SQL optimization; integrated Flyway alongside Liquibase for seamless migration versioning

Boosted personal and team delivery speed by integrating AI-assisted engineering workflows: developed custom prompt-skills, and orchestrated AI Agents using Opencode, specialized plugins, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) services

Explored cloud-native innovations by driving a PoC initiative leveraging GraalVM Native Images to optimize container cold-start efficiency within microservices; managed services configuration via Spring Cloud
Transitioned legacy modules to reactive programming with Spring WebFlux and R2DBC, significantly increasing application throughput
Optimized enterprise CI/CD pipelines using Maven, Gradle, and GitHub Actions within GitLab, incorporating automated static code analysis via SonarQube
Boosted codebase reliability by increasing unit and integration test coverage (JUnit, Mockito, Mockk, Testcontainers, WireMock) to 80%+, resulting in a ~35% drop in production incidents
Troubleshooting and resolving complex production incidents utilizing Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana for root cause analysis (RCA)
